_comment: The official Senso agent skills, as published to the Shipables registry from the senso-skills repository. src/commands/skills.ts must list exactly these. Refreshed by .github/workflows/spec-drift.yml; a mismatch means either the registry moved or the CLI's list did. These five superseded the seven task-shaped skills (search, ingest, content-gen, brand-setup, kb-organize, review-publish, onboarding), which remain installable by name but are no longer what --all means.
